name: Tom de Groot
specialism: System and algorithm design, math and ML research
profile: I work as an agentic engineer on full stack design, algorithms, and mathematical proofs and formalizations. At SoundImports I am the project owner of Acqui, our in-house purchasing and data analysis tool. Outside work, I co-authored a set theory preprint and orchestrated its full formalization in Lean. I like creating and solving competitive programming puzzles. Besides that, I play Magic: The Gathering and squash, go bouldering, and like hiking.

entries.title: AI engineer
bullets: Project owner of Acqui, SoundImports' in-house purchasing and data analysis tool.
Build the application end to end: algorithms, AWS hosting, data lake design, and UI/UX.

entries.title: Vopěnka's Principle without Choice: Preservation under Symmetric Extensions
entries.authors: Tom de Groot and Wojciech Aleksander Wołoszyn
bullets: Co-authored our paper using initial AI-led proofs, rewriting and adding substantially to them.
Led the orchestration of a 300,000-line Lean proof over 5 days, repairing and auditing upstream papers and arguments along the way.

entries.title: First Proof, Problem 9
bullets: Built a persistent pipeline for a Lean-verified solution in 3 days and 2,500 lines of Lean. Daniel Litt identified it as the only credible formalized solution he knew of.

entries.title: Open-source formalization
bullets: Prill's problem on Daniel Litt's problem list: solved in all genera with GPT-5.6.
New Foundations: 17,174-line Lean proof that NF refutes the weak partition principle.
PrimeNumberTheoremAnd: merged Lean proofs built with Aristotle and AI agents.

entries.title: HeXO
bullets: Built and trained a self-play MCTS engine with custom GPU kernels written in Triton, and designed a novel graph-search scheduling algorithm for it.

entries.title: MoleculeResolver
bullets: Refactored the system design and improved its RDKit stereochemistry scoring.

entries.title: Bazaar_ML, ParetoProof, Alternaut, ProjectEulerBot
bullets: ML training environment for The Bazaar, plus other systems projects and contributions.

entries.title: Competitive programming
bullets: Create and solve competitive programming puzzles, including five kata on Codewars.

entries.title: BSc Chemistry
entries.thesis: Evaluating and Optimizing NMR Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
bullets: Worked on graph neural network methods for NMR prediction in the Pollice Group. Created clean datasets and ran hyperparameter optimization with Optuna on HPC using Slurm.
